source.purpose: Post-revamp release stabilization blast-radius audit for commit 4bda59b and follow-up hardening.

overall.note: Previous user-reported final detect-changes showed 107 affected flows. Current compare after re-analysis groups the same revamp surface into 78 affected processes.

highestRiskFlows.missingCoverage: Clean native screenshot set remains blocked; Widget Studio native handoff is validated through web/screenshots and native build launch only.
highestRiskFlows.actionTaken: Added StudyPlannerBrain preset save/load/reset fixture and golden scenario sp-brain-core-loop-truth.

highestRiskFlows.missingCoverage: Native screenshots of theme variations are not cleanly captured.
highestRiskFlows.actionTaken: Regression fixture now asserts applyTheme and widget preset metadata persistence.

highestRiskFlows.missingCoverage: No device-level RTL/large-text capture in this pass.
highestRiskFlows.actionTaken: Existing planner trust checks cover impossible dates/times; new Brain fixture covers missing-date parsed review work.

highestRiskFlows.missingCoverage: No native screenshot for invalid-time state.
highestRiskFlows.actionTaken: Planner trust fixture asserts invalid deadlines stay out of calendar/upcoming and stay visible in Needs Review.
Brain fixture asserts applyLocale updates settings/profile; localization gate retained.
Localization validation remains a release gate.

highestRiskFlows.missingCoverage: No native screenshot of all-complete/all-overdue state in this pass.
highestRiskFlows.actionTaken: Brain fixture asserts completion updates status, progress, checklist, and downstream widget data.

highestRiskFlows.missingCoverage: No manual simulator navigation screenshots without prompt overlay.
highestRiskFlows.actionTaken: Regression coverage targets invalid/missing deadline paths.
Invalid time remains review-visible and non-schedulable in test:planner.
Planner trust fixture validates due-today, week-load, and calendar grouping stay on the same date truth.

coverageStrategy: Keep release hardening narrow: cover shared Brain selectors/helpers rather than changing every affected screen.
Use native build validation to prove SDK mismatch is not an app-code blocker.
Use web fallback screenshots and existing scorecards as visual evidence until clean simulator screenshots are available.
